resources.string: Keep track of the medicines in your home: what you have, who it\'s for, where it\'s kept and when it expires.
MediShelf is a record-keeping tool. It does not give medical advice, diagnose conditions or recommend treatment.
Always follow your doctor\'s or pharmacist\'s instructions about doses and whether a medicine is right for someone.
Information you enter or scan can be wrong. Check the pack and leaflet before using any medicine.
In an emergency or suspected poisoning, call your local emergency number or poison control centre straight away.
Your records stay on this device, encrypted. MediShelf has no internet access, accounts, ads or analytics.
I understand MediShelf is not medical advice
